# Game reference

What the game contains, exported from the assets the game plays. For how the rules work, see the design docs in `Docs/Design/`.

| Page | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Towers](Towers.md) | 9 tower types: cost, stats, abilities, passives |
| [Enemies](Enemies.md) | 14 enemies: stats, abilities, passives, where they appear |
| [Statuses](Statuses.md) | Statuses the towers and enemies can apply or carry |
| [Levels](Levels.md) | 2 chapters, 8 levels: maps, energy, waves, rewards |
| [Codex](Codex.md) | What the in-game Codex lists, in order, and the full text of its tips |

Reading the numbers: HP is the most a unit has. Speed is tiles per move. Range is in tiles from the user. A cooldown is in its owner's turns (1 = usable every turn). Enemy cooldowns count down at the start of the player's turn.
